title: Synapze
tagline: Synapze is a one-click AI agent hosting platform built for Eliza-based agents. Enjoy streamlined deployment and real-time monitoring.
description:
Synapze is an AI hosting platform specifically designed to deploy autonomous agents built using the ElizaOS framework, providing a streamlined solution that makes advanced AI deployment accessible for both seasoned developers and newcomers alike. At its core, Synapze simplifies the entire process of launching AI agents by offering a one-click deployment feature that eliminates the usual complexities associated with traditional setups. This means that instead of grappling with numerous manual steps, users can instantly bring their AI agents online with minimal effort.

The platform stands out by offering multiple deployment options to different user preferences and technical expertise. Whether you prefer to manually enter agent details through an intuitive form, upload a pre-configured characterfile in JSON format, or choose from a variety of predefined templates, Synapze adapts to your workflow. 
This flexibility allows you to create detailed, customized agents that reflect your desired personality and style, making it possible to fine-tune their behavior, tone, and interaction patterns with precision.

Security and seamless integration are also central to the Synapze experience. Essential credentials, including those required for external services like Discord, Twitter, Farcaster, etc... and LLM providers, are managed securely through environment variables. This integrated approach not only safeguards sensitive information but also ensures that your agent has reliable access to the services it needs to function properly. Once deployment is initiated, Synapze provides real-time monitoring and updates through a dedicated progress page, allowing you to track the agent's status from start to finish. 

Synapze simplifies AI agents integration with advanced on-chain capabilities through Coinbase AgentKit/OnchainKit and Autonomous Verifiable Services (AVS). This powerful combination allows developers to build and deploy sophisticated, blockchain-integrated AI agents with unprecedented ease and reliability.

Synapze not only simplifies the deployment and management of AI agents with its user-friendly interface and extensive documentation but also pushes the boundaries of innovation by integrating on-chain functionalities. This unique blend of AI and blockchain technology enables the creation of intelligent, autonomous agents that can interact with both digital data and decentralized networks.
how_its_made:
This project is using a streamlined, modern tech stack. Our backend is written in TypeScript with REST and GraphQL APIs, while our blockchain interactions rely on Solidity smart contracts and Rust modules for performance-critical tasks. A PostgreSQL database handles our persistent storage.

To enable onchain functionality, we integrated Coinbase’s AgentKit and OnchainKit—these toolkits empower our AI agents to access crypto wallets and perform blockchain transactions, and they simplify app development with ergonomic, pre-built components. 

We also leveraged the EigenLayer SDK to enhance security and scalability. A custom middleware layer bridges our web APIs with blockchain operations, handling tasks like transaction batching and error reconciliation. 

This careful orchestration, along with a few hacky scripts for data conversion, allowed us to seamlessly merge offchain and onchain features into a cohesive, efficient platform.
